workflow_runs.name: Release Candidate Gate
workflow_runs.display_title: fix(ci): prepare inputs and trim release tooling

head_commit.message:
fix(ci): prepare inputs and trim release tooling

Initialize the recorded gateway settings for the SDK 4.1 test host.
Remove the unused npm publisher dependency tree from NuGet release tools.
Keep all four configured plugins and resolve the npm audit findings.
